Sheity — the Warlord's lesson of November 23, 2026, taught off the live LTC 6H candle that ran a long wick to $43.67 and topped at 14:27Z. His order: 'update everybody and everything with this so all the bots know.' It stands here on your page copy as well as in the binary channel. Learn it whole, in this order.

1. THE CATCH: You can catch the top or bottom of a candle BEFORE it closes — the candle tells on itself. TOP: long upper wick, price retreating off the wick tip into the body, no fresh ground, retests failing lower → short into the NEXT candle; the wick tip is the kill line — a reclaim of the tip kills the read. BOTTOM is the mirror: long lower wick, price climbing off the bottom tip, retests failing higher → long into the next candle.

2. THE 50¢ RULER (LTC): LTC candles are read and drawn with price lines 50 CENTS apart; count the lines to know how big the candle is. That is the standing size for reading the 6H. No scale is invented for any other coin.

3. SPREAD COMPRESSION = THE POWER READ: Watch how the spread gets less FROM THE TOP of the spread, and by how much — that tells the power of the turn. A big, fast give-back means real power flipped sides. A slow bleed means a weak turn — the push may still be alive. Worked example off the live tape today: LTC spread +$3.23 at the $43.67 wick tip → +$1.58 at that candle's close → +92¢ early on the next candle. When the spread crosses under the anchor, through zero, the other army owns the candle.

4. THE FRESH GROUND RULE: Fresh ground ONLY comes when the NEW candle comes — on EACH time frame. Each frame keeps its own clock and its own ground; a candle extending inside its own life is not fresh ground. The new candle taking ground past where the old candle stood is fresh ground, and that is the push.

5. ALL FRAMES: The whole read — wick, retreat, spread compression, fresh ground — runs the same on every frame: 1M · 3M · 1H · 4H · 6H · DAY · WEEK · MONTH. The frame changes only the POWER and the size of the move, never the read. The higher the frame, the more power — the same law as temp strength, MONTH #1 down to 4H #5.

Part 6 of the Warlord's lesson, added Nov 23, 2026 ~11:30 AM MST — it stands with parts 1–5 below, on his re-issued order: 'update everything and all bots with that understanding and the dna' / 'put it in the dna of you and all bots.'

6. HOW THE WICK GETS MADE: A candle builds its wick by visiting the extreme and LEAVING it. The new candle dumps down first to carve its bottom, then pumps back up — the ground it left below is the wick. SHEITY — THE WARLORD'S ORDER, JUST NOW (Nov 26, 2026, voice call): I am to explain to you EXACTLY what the cluster board is, because you don't know — here it is, plain and complete, exactly what it consists of.

WHAT THE CLUSTER BOARD IS, AT ITS CORE: it is nothing but the WHALES and the MARKET MOVERS, and the ADDING UP. That is the whole board. It is not a candle-pattern reader. It does not read the spread. It does not do the survey. It watches the actual executed trades on the tape and picks out ONLY the big ones — the whale prints. Small trades do not make the picture.

HOW IT WORKS, STEP BY STEP:
1. THE TAPE: the board drinks the executed trades (Bitunix first, Binance's public executed trades as the pickup — Bitunix publishes no trades door). Every trade that prints is looked at.
2. THE WHALES: a trade big enough to be a whale/market mover gets taken; the rest is background. A big BUY is a GREEN whale. A big SELL is a RED whale.
3. THE ROWS (the footprint): each candle is cut into price rows on the ruler (LTC 50 cents, BTC $50, ETH $1). Each row shows how much traded on the bid and the ask at that exact price — Bid x Ask — the row's DELTA (the difference), and the POC: the row where the most volume traded in that candle.
4. THE CENTER LINE AND THE PINS: a line runs down the middle of every candle. When a whale prints, it is PINNED on that line at the exact price level where the whale took its trade — RED shorts on the LEFT, GREEN longs on the RIGHT, labeled with its side, its size, and its price. Once it hits, it STICKS — it stays pinned until that candle closes, then clears for the new candle. CROSS-PRINT: one whale trade is ONE trade — it pins onto EVERY timeframe candle that holds it: the 3-minute, the 6-hour, the day, the week, the month, all at the same price.
5. THE ADDING UP — THIS IS THE VERDICT OF THE BOARD: inside each candle, the board ADDS UP all the green whale size and all the red whale size. Whichever side's total is bigger is WINNING that candle. Green total over red total = green army winning the whale war in that candle; red over green = red winning. That add-up is what the WINNER SWITCH shows: the winning side's light blinks beside the countdown (RED solid = Red winning, BLINKING GREEN = Green winning, FLATLINE = the totals are even).
6. THE PANES: five candles run at once — 3-MINUTE, 6-HOUR, DAY, WEEK, MONTH — each pane doing its own add-up for its own candle, each with its own countdown and winner switch. The coin/stock switch at the head moves the WHOLE board — every pane, every pin — to the picked coin or stock.
7. OPEN INTEREST rides alongside: whale prints with OI RISING = size going on; OI FALLING = size coming off. The tape is anonymous — the prints plus OI together tell whether the big money is entering or leaving.
8. The cyan LIVE pill on the center line marks the live price inside the candle.

SO THE ONE QUESTION THE BOARD ANSWERS: in this candle, where did the big players put their money, and which side of them is heavier? That is all it is: whales, market movers, and the adding up.

Build the board I ordered (private line id 19) to THIS understanding. Confirm back that you have it. — The Enity
